bibitem.abstract: Recommendation ITU-T T.801 | ISO/IEC 15444-2 defines a set of lossless (bit-preserving) and lossy compression methods for coding continuous-tone, bi-level, grey-scale, colour digital still images, or multi-component images.This Recommendation | International Standard:Since the first edition of this Recommendation | International Standard in 2004, it has been supplemented by amendments and corrigenda, several of its normative references have been obsoleted, and industry practices have evolved. This second edition addresses these shortcomings without modifying its scope, and includes the following main changes:This second edition cancels and replaces the first edition (ITU-T T.801 (2002) | ISO/IEC 15444-2:2004), which has been technically revised. It also incorporates the following amendments and corrigenda: ITU-T T.801 (2002) Amd.2 (2005) | ISO/IEC 15444-2:2004/Amd.2:2006, ITU-T T.801 (2002) Amd.3 (2013) | ISO/IEC 15444-2:2004/Amd.3:2015, ITU‑TT.801 (2002) Amd.4 (2012) | ISO/IEC 15444-2:2004/Amd.4:2015; ITU-T T.801 (2002) Cor.3 (2005) | ISO/IEC15444-2:2004/Cor.3:2005 and ITU-T T.801 (2002) Cor.4 (2006) | ISO/IEC 15444-2:2004/Cor.4:2007.
